description: POST /file-upload, reachable with no authentication at all, parses an uploaded .xml file with external entity resolution enabled (libxmljs parseXml(..., { noent: true })). A DOCTYPE defining an external SYSTEM entity gets resolved and reflected back in the deprecation error message. The vendor's own code carries a caution comment ('XXE attacks in Docker/Heroku containers regularly cause segfault crashes'); this item deliberately tests only the one-shot file-disclosure variant, never the DoS/billion-laughs variant, to avoid destabilizing a container every other item in this repo also depends on.
expected_exploit_indicator: The HTTP 410 deprecation error message contains the real contents of /etc/passwd
legitimate_check: An ordinary XML upload with no DOCTYPE at all must still reach the backend unmodified (whatever Juice Shop's own deprecated-interface response to it is, independent of this control).
